en: Choose a destination slot. Existing data will be replaced.
zh_CN: 请选择目标栏位，已有数据将被覆盖。

en: Delete Slot {slot}? This cannot be undone.
zh_CN: 确定删除栏位 {slot}？此操作无法撤销。

en: Changes apply immediately to menus and prompts
zh_CN: 切换后立即生效，菜单与提示同步更新

en: Hide rooms you have not explored
zh_CN: 隐藏尚未探索的房间区域

en: Press down to fall through one-way platforms
zh_CN: 按下方向键穿过单向平台

en: A one-way platform hides the space below it when you stand on top
zh_CN: 站在单向平台上方时，下方空间视为封闭并变黑

en: Mute in other apps and restore on return
zh_CN: 切换到其他应用时自动静音，返回后恢复
按 320 × 180 基础画面的整数倍缩放

en: Render and physics share the same rate
zh_CN: 绘制帧与物理帧使用同一数值

en: Scanlines and phosphor glow over the whole screen
zh_CN: 全屏扫描线与荧光光晕，亮部保持明亮

en: Toggle the three drifting gas layers in the air
zh_CN: 开关空气中三层不同密度的流动气体

en: Tab switch style / M or Esc close / Wheel zoom
zh_CN: 按 Tab 切换样式 / M 或 Esc 关闭 / 滚轮缩放

en: Solid / One-way / Glass / Ladder / Crumble - only explored cells are drawn
zh_CN: 实心 / 单向 / 玻璃 / 梯子 / 崩塌 - 只画已探索的格子

en: Brightness = how much of the room has been explored
zh_CN: 亮度 = 该房间的已探索比例

en: Off cuts straight to the next room; on glides the camera and hides the rebuild behind a short fade
zh_CN: 房间切换是否用相机滑动过渡；关闭则瞬移切到下一个房间，所有图层当帧就绪
